results.title: Mistral Voxtral 3 Cuts Full Voice Agent Pipeline to One SDK at $0.04/min, Beats Whisper
results.content: Voxtral 3 uses a cascaded three-stage pipeline running on LiveKit's open-source WebRTC infrastructure. When a user speaks, Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 receives the audio stream, transcribes it in real time, identifies the speaker through diarization, and detects when the speaker has finished using prosodic cues — replacing the fixed silence thresholds that make traditional IVR systems sound robotic. The transcript passes to a reasoning model — Mistral Small 4 or a developer-substituted alternative — which generates a response and, if needed, calls external tools such as calendar APIs or customer databases via function calling. The response text passes to Voxtral Mini TTS 3, which begins generating audio before the full response is complete, streaming audio back to users in real time. [...] The full voice agent pipeline with Mistral Small 4 as the reasoning model is priced at $0.04 per minute. OpenAI's Realtime API works out to up to approximately $0.10 per minute for combined audio input and output; Deepgram's Nova-2 transcription alone is approximately $0.075 per minute, without an integrated LLM or TTS component. Voxtral 3's rate is roughly 40 to 60 percent below the nearest comparable full-stack alternative. Transcription-only pricing runs $0.0035 per minute (Mini batch), $0.004 per minute (Small), and $0.008 per minute (Realtime). Text-to-speech is $13 per million characters. These prices are for the cloud API; the STT models are Apache 2.0 licensed for unrestricted self-hosting, but the TTS model carries a CC BY-NC 4.0 license that requires a commercial agreement from [...] Voxtral 3 is not Mistral's first attempt at voice. The company launched its initial speech-understanding models in July 2025, followed by Voxtral Transcribe 2 in February 2026 and Voxtral TTS — the first text-to-speech release, supporting 9 languages — in March 2026. What distinguishes the third generation from predecessors is the shift from individual capable components to an opinionated, wired-together stack with an SDK and a single-vendor pricing model.

# Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK

By

Mistral AI just released Voxtral 3. Mistral Voxtral 3 is a speech model family paired with a voice agent SDK. It ships 3 transcription models, 1 text-to-speech model and an SDK built on LiveKit. One place for listening, reasoning, tool calls and speaking. All 4 models are in public preview on the Mistral API.

## TL;DR [...] Mistral lists 4 models and 1 SDK:

 Voxtral Small Transcribe 3: flagship batch transcription and diarization. Docs also list translation, speech Q&A, summarization and function calling.
 Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3: a 4B model for cheaper, faster batch jobs.
 Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime 3: streaming ASR over WebSocket with end-of-turn detection.
 Voxtral Speech 3: text-to-speech, also called Voxtral Mini TTS 3 in the post.

All transcription models support diarization and context biasing. Context biasing takes key terms or free text to improve recall. results.content:
Oct 20, 2026

Mistral AI has launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents. The system includes a speech-to-text model (Voxtral Small Transcribe 3), a text-to-speech model (Voxtral Mini TTS 3), and a voice agent SDK based on LiveKit. Together, they combine listening, thinking, tool use, and speaking into a single streaming pipeline. Transcription covers more than 50 languages. Text-to-speech output supports over 35 languages and 50 dialects with emotional adaptation. Agents can tap into external systems during live conversations, for example, to book appointments or check invoices. [...] Mistral says the system can run on your own infrastructure or through EU-hosted APIs to keep data under your control. Pricing starts at $0.0035 per minute for transcription. More details are in the documentation.

results.title: Mistral Voxtral 3: AI Voice Agents That Can Listen, Think, Speak, and Actually Get Things Done
results.content:
That is the problem Mistral AI is targeting with Voxtral 3, announced on October 20, 2026.

Voxtral 3 combines a new family of speech-to-text and text-to-speech models with a voice agent SDK. The idea is to bring speech recognition, reasoning, tool calling, and speech generation into a single real-time streaming pipeline.

Instead of building a voice assistant by stitching together a collection of unrelated services, developers get a more integrated foundation for building conversational AI agents.

Official announcement: 

## What is Voxtral 3?

Voxtral 3 is not a single model. It is a collection of speech models and agent infrastructure designed to handle different parts of a voice interaction.

The main components are: [...] Contact-centre automation: The SDK’s support for SIP and WebRTC makes it relevant to phone-based and browser-based conversations. SIP is a standard protocol used in internet telephony, while WebRTC enables real-time audio and video communication in browsers and applications.

These are potential use cases, not proof that every application will work reliably out of the box. Each one requires suitable tools, permissions, error handling, and evaluation.

## 9. Voxtral 3 is not a complete replacement for application engineering

There is an easy mistake to make when looking at voice agent announcements: assuming that a model with tool calling can safely operate an entire business workflow without much additional engineering.

It cannot. [...] The main components are:

   Voxtral Small Transcribe 3: A high-accuracy speech recognition model for multilingual transcription, speaker identification, and domain-specific vocabulary.
   Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3: A smaller transcription model designed for efficient, cost-effective processing.
   Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime 3: A streaming transcription model for applications where waiting for an entire recording to finish is not practical.
   Voxtral Speech 3: A text-to-speech model that generates expressive speech, supports voice adaptation, and follows instructions about pronunciation and delivery.
   Voxtral Voice Agent SDK: An SDK that connects incoming speech, a reasoning model, external tools, and generated speech into a conversational application.
